Article 2 (Procedures for On-Site Investigations)
(1) When conducting an on-site investigation under Article 4 (2) of the Enforcement Decree of the Polar Activities Promotion Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Decree"), the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries may request the heads of relevant institutions or organizations to cooperate in the following matters:
1. Entry into restricted-access areas under their jurisdiction;
2. Inspection or submission of relevant materials.
(2) When making a request for cooperation under paragraph (1), the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall formulate an on-site investigation plan and notify the head of the relevant institution or organization of the plan no later than 10 days before the investigation commences.
